m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>As you place the second Gem, the Alphyn Statue's eyes light up with a magical glow. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>There is a soft rumble of thunder and the sound of waves crashing on a distant shore. Suddenly the waters begin to rush again. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The waterfall splashes merrily, and a cool mist rises. The Pool of Radiance is replenished! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You think you've collected enough water to heal any wound. </ITALICS>
What do you know! I was only mostly dead! I'm going to have to revise that theorem.
Now why are you here? To find the Lady, of course. Nothing could be simpler!
The Lady of the Lake has been trapped above the waters of Nimue, in the halls of the Dolorous Tower.
How could she have done it? Hmm... the simplest answer is she must have stolen the Gems from the magical Alphyn Statues.
Did she do it herself? Doubtful. She most likely had the Stag Chargers do it.
Defeat the Stag Chargers to get back the Gems and restore the Alphyn Statues.
If the Pool of Radiance replenishes, I might still be brought back from death's door!
What are you standing around for? You need to get the Gems from the Stag Chargers to restore the Alphyn Statues.
Not that there's much chance of it, with such a complicated scheme, but if the Pool refills bring me some water to save my life!
